title: Finite localization and exact coefficient-family records
statement: For the raw rational coefficient stages [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], a finite exact coefficient-family record consists of a stage-system morphism, integer shift, additive and triangulated structures on each finite functor, shift compatibility of every beta, and the scalar-unit equation. For complementary closed/open immersions over a finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], define a finite localization data record with the actual finite localization packages [def-sf-rational-localization-data], normalized compact-support coefficient action [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action], closed direct-image family, and the two prescribed pullback families [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Include the four finite exact records, normalized finite adjunctions, inverse-pullback-mate closed beta, and compatible unit/counit families with their finite equations. This is a record of finite data only; it asserts no existence or descended property.

source.place: The rational and algebraically closed coefficient stages; finite-stage descent detail in steps 1--5 of lem-sf-qbar-localization-common-stage
